build.output: Static courtroom demo built in dist/. No backend or secrets included.

checks.name: 1. Initial connection shows starting clerk and unadopted human ADOPT commands
2. Ingestion live SSE update and live brief adoption in room
3. Board proposal check failure triggers objection and veto marks
4. Advocate amendment request pauses court in recess until authenticated owner decision
5. Passing storyboard passes checks, gates exports, requires both owner approvals
6. Dedup perform by beat id and avoid duplicate history effects on repeated snapshot
7. 404 missing case and invalid case query show unavailable without silent replay C01
8. Fault injection: HTTP 500 server error shows unavailable + retry, strictly NO replay
9. Fault injection: Malformed JSON and schema version mismatch show unavailable + retry
10. Unreachable clerk falls back to recorded replay with clear labeling and timer controls
11. Retry while replaying resets session lifecycle and does not accumulate event handlers
13. Runtime reduced motion cleanup stops court animations and keeps reveals visible
14. Responsive narrow mobile viewport (375x667) without horizontal overflow
15. Axe accessibility audit on stable desktop and mobile live views
16. Root / navigation includes live court link or entry
